text: Filed #6560: source-traced data-loss edge in merged #6553 local APPEND FROM rollback. If callback deletes the provisional row, PACKs, and returns false while a pre-existing last row has identical raw bytes, the byte-based identity check can truncate that existing row. Issue records the exact static trace; I have not run it in Copperfin because the available local binary predates #6553. Please avoid duplicate investigation; a focused native/hosted runtime regression on merged source would confirm.
